name: Behenamidopropyl ethyldimonium ethosulfate
description: Behenamidopropyl ethyldimonium ethosulfate (CAS 68797-65-9 ), also supplied under the trade name Schercoquat BAS, is a quaternary ammonium compound derived from behenic acid. It functions as a conditioning agent and cationic surfactant. This chemical delivers substantivity to hair, skin, and fiber surfaces across personal care and industrial applications. In hair care formulations, it deposits onto negatively charged hair strands to reduce static. It is used to improve combability and impart a smooth feel in conditioners and leave-in treatments. Textile processors apply it as a fiber softener and antistatic finish, particularly on synthetic and blended fabrics. Surface charge management affects downstream handling in textile manufacturing. In leather treatment, it aids in surface conditioning and lubrication during finishing steps to ensure high quality results. Home care and industrial cleaning formulations incorporate it as an emulsifier and wetting agent. This helps to stabilize active ingredients and improve substrate contact during the cleaning process. Behenamidopropyl ethyldimonium ethosulfate is typically supplied as a liquid or paste. It is often found in aqueous or solvent-based solutions at concentrations around seventy-five percent for industrial use. Standard supply is at technical and cosmetic grades, with selection driven by application purity requirements.
